verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents ways to automate a tailnet, including infrastructure-as-code providers and webhooks, and a policy file editor. None of this evidence shows first-party versioning, review, or rollback of those automations or policy changes. Any versioning gained by keeping IaC in a user's own git repo is a user-side workaround and earns no credit, as does the community Slack-bot flow that resets ACLs.
